visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit retail environment. A store shelf displays Chacott cosmetics. A large poster featuring a woman's face with professional makeup is prominent. Some shelf slots are empty, marked with pink 'sold out!' and 'sold' graphics. (2) The camera zooms in on a Chacott Shaping Primer display. A hand with a gold ring reaches in and picks up a grey tube (shade 002). (3) The hand holds the grey tube against a pink and white background for a close-up product reveal. (4) A vertical poster is shown, displaying 'Before' and 'After' headshots of a woman to demonstrate the product's contouring effect. (5) The scene shifts to another shelf for 'excel' products. A hand touches an empty display slot, emphasizing that the Lumical Reflect Powder is out of stock. (6) A promotional image of the excel Lumical Reflect Powder in its compact is shown on screen as a cutaway. (7) The camera pans to a Yunth Vitamin C Tone Up UV display. Several pink tubes are visible on the shelf. (8) A hand squeezes a small amount of beige cream onto the back of another hand. The cream is spread smoothly across the skin. (9) The camera shows a close-up of the hand after the cream has been blended, highlighting a brighter and smoother skin texture. (10) The video concludes with a wide shot of the Ainz & Tulpe cosmetic store interior, showing multiple aisles filled with various beauty products under bright white lighting.
